mcq_drop.why: dubious: attributes Chera/Pandya/Chola product split specifically to Pliny; obscure and not well established

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: Sangam literature; Sangam texts do describe trade and ports

patterns: Single-fact items dominate: Third Sangam at Madurai; Tolkappiyam = grammar; Silappadikaram by Ilango; Kural = Laghuveda.
APPSC Group-1 tests Sangam society terms (Vellalars = rich peasants, fourth caste) rather than corpus lists.
UPSC-style statement trap: Sangam poets knew varna; 'devoid of material culture/warrior ethic' are false.
App adds anthology/idyll lists, foreign sources and new excavations (Keezhadi, Pugalur) beyond PYQ depth; few items on Sangam social classes.
